headline: Dumud Soil Improver
title: Dumud | Attack Boost For Ground Pals | Palworld Guide
video_script: Ground Pals hit harder with Dumud around. Its partner skill, Soil Improver, raises the Attack of Ground Pals in your party, and it does not stack. At base it works Watering and Mining, both at level two, and it sometimes drops High Quality Pal Oil at the Ranch. Do you use Dumud for mining or for the boost? Comment below!
description: Dumud in Palworld 1.0: Soil Improver boosts Ground Pal attack, plus Watering level two and Mining level two.
